text_block_list.text: Walking through the plaza that day—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Waaaaah~?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Jeez! What's with that reaction?!
Are you making fun of my magic?!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
N-No, I didn't, I didn't!
I didn't do it at all~!
choice_data_list: What on earth are you doing...?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer, wanna join in too?
As my magical test subject!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Fufun. It's a brand new one I just learned from Grandma!
It's magic that gets you super motivated!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Still, even when I cast magic on Kitasan, she just fools around going 'Woooow~!'
She isn't taking it seriously at aall!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm sorry~. Next time for sure,
I'll feel completely motivated~...!

Despite being pushed around, Kitasan Black
covers for her without placing any blame.
Could it be that she's—
choice_data_list: Enduring the bullying from the wicked witch...!?
You don't want Sweep Tosho to hate you, huh.
You don't want Sweep Tosho to hate you, do you?

text_block_list.text:
Despite being pushed around, Kitasan Black
covers for her without placing any blame.
Could it be that she's—
choice_data_list: Enduring the bullying from the wicked witch...!?
You don't want Sweep Tosho to hate you, huh.
You don't want Sweep Tosho to hate you, do you?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Haaaah!? What do you mean, bullying!?
Besides, I'm not an evil witch!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Right, Kitasan!?
Say something back to them!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Y-Yeah!
It's just as Sweep-san says!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
It's true Sweep-san has quite a temper,
and once she starts being selfish,
she can be completely unmanageable at times, but...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...Kitasan?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Awawa, sorry! But I figured I should just be completely honest right now.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"...Actually, Sweep-san called out to me
when I was feeling down about getting
a bad score on a test."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"She told me she'd cast a special spell on me,
one she's never cast on anyone before."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
She's a bit clumsy and often gets misunderstood...
but she's truly a very kind girl.
choice_data_list: I see. Guess I was worrying for nothing.
I see, guess I was worrying for nothing then.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. No no,
I'm just glad I could tell you all the great things about my wonderful friend, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...Huh?
Sweep?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what, idiot idiot idiot!
Why are you suddenly complimenting me?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I-I don't get it!
My face feels... all hot, too...!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Jeez, you idiot!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Huh, Sweep-san!?
Umm, in times like this—
choice_data_list: Let's chase after them for now!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: You're totally right!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Wait up~!
Sweep-saaan!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh!? Come on, stop it!
I told you to stop chasing me~!
And so, Kitasan Black and I spent our time running all over the school building, desperately trying to catch a bright-red Sweep Tosho...

As a postscript to the story, thanks to that,
they apparently gained just a bit of stamina.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Gulp...!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...? What's that?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Why should I have to hate Kitasan?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? But I saw her talking to a cat earlier, saying,
'I won't be friends with anyone who doesn't listen
to what I say or fall under my magic'...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, was that what you
were worried about? Silly!
A familiar is completely different from a magical practice dummy, you know?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
A familiar has to do what I say...
but... Hey, Kitasan. Close your eyes.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Huh.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Sanidine☆Anortho☆Moonstone!
Awaken, my inner drive and energy!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...Well? Did the magic work?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Just tell the hooonest truth.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ...I didn't rush.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Yep. In that case—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Sanidine☆Anortho☆Moonstone!
Awaken, my inner drive and energy!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Wah!?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Sanidine☆Anortho☆Moonstone!
Awaken, my inner drive and energy!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Again?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Because you're my practice dummy,
after all. I'll cast magic on you as many times
as it takes until it works!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Tomorrow, the day after, too!
I'm not gonna start hating you that easily.
Humph!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
…………Ah, hahaha.
In the end, you cast magic on me again and again, didn't you?
choice_data_list: Maybe you actually succeeded at least once?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Hmm, that's...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Tomorrow, the day after, too!
I'm not gonna start hating you that easily.
Humph!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Maybe just a little bit, it might be cast on me.
...Because even now, my heart feels so warm.
Kitasan Black let out a shy, bashful smile.
